Generate, estimate, and report random-effects mixture ('remix') models
for meta-analysis. Model estimation relies on 'OpenMx', and tidy
reporting relies occurs via 'tidySEM'. The resulting models can be
further customized and used for auxiliary variable analyses.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cv_enumeration()`](https://cjvanlissa.github.io/metamixture/reference/cv_enumeration.md)
  : Cross-Validated Class Enumeration

- [`icl()`](https://cjvanlissa.github.io/metamixture/reference/icl.md) :
  Integrated Completed Likelihood (ICL) for any mixture model

- [`pmc_surprisal()`](https://cjvanlissa.github.io/metamixture/reference/pmc_surprisal.md)
  : Class Enumeration Using Predictive Surprisal

- [`remix()`](https://cjvanlissa.github.io/metamixture/reference/remix.md)
  : Random-Effects Mixture Meta-Analysis

- [`sandwich_remix()`](https://cjvanlissa.github.io/metamixture/reference/sandwich_remix.md)
  :

  Cluster-Robust Standard Errors for `remix` Models

- [`sim_remix_fixed_tau()`](https://cjvanlissa.github.io/metamixture/reference/sim_remix_fixed_tau.md)
  : Simulate Data from a Random-Effects Mixture Model

- [`surprisal()`](https://cjvanlissa.github.io/metamixture/reference/surprisal.md)
  : Calculate Surprisal Using Kernel Density Estimation
